Definition: properly, to cover, i.e. (in a sinister sense) to act covertly
BiblicalUsage: Chapha is acting covertly, and it appears once: the children of Israel did secretly those things that were not right against the LORD their God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the single verse names the root of Israel's fall: sin done in secret, as if God could not see it.
